scenario_title: Engine upgrade applied immediately at peak
title: Connection failures on billing-svc
impact: Requests failed while connections were refused on billing-svc
symptom: [ANOMALY] billing-svc 2026-06-02 18:35-21:35: billing-svc: 141 of 215 log lines were non-INFO between 2026-06-02 18:35 and 2026-06-02 21:35 UTC (peak error ratio 0.91 vs baseline median 0.0). 2 error templates, 0 first seen in this span.
error_templates: c.f.b.api.UsageController - account <*> requested usage for a closed period

_templates.macro: Terraform change upgraded {svc} with apply_immediately = true; the Multi-AZ failover happened at peak and JVM clients kept stale connections and DNS for minutes.
_templates.remediation: Set apply_immediately back to false (maintenance window); cap JVM DNS TTL at 30 s; enable pool validation.

culprit.diff:
@@ -14,3 +14,3 @@ aws_db_instance.billing_db
 resource "aws_db_instance" "billing_db" {
-  apply_immediately = "false"
+  apply_immediately = "true"
   tags = local.tags

rca.macro: Terraform change upgraded billing-db with apply_immediately = true; the Multi-AZ failover happened at peak and JVM clients kept stale connections and DNS for minutes.
rca.micro: infra/billing-db.tf:15 sets rds_apply_immediately false -> true on aws_db_instance.billing_db.
rca.remediation: Set apply_immediately back to false (maintenance window); cap JVM DNS TTL at 30 s; enable pool validation.

action_items: Require a reviewed `terraform plan` and a CloudWatch alarm for the changed AWS resource.
Alert on the error signature `c.f.b.repo.InvoiceRepository - call to billing-db failed: <*> <*> <*> <*> <*> <*`.
